context: M13 o2. Earl's stand in the rain under an awning. He opens a small cloth-bound book.

lines.speaker: char.earl_poole
lines.text: Every man on this street plays a number. Cops play the biggest.

lines.speaker: char.earl_poole
lines.text: Thirty years I've written down who I pay. Dates. Amounts. Badge numbers.

lines.speaker: char.earl_poole
lines.text: State's got a lottery and I'm still here. I want to be here when they're not.

lines.speaker: char.earl_poole
lines.text: Brannock comes at eleven. Stand under the theatre awning. Good light there.
